summary: Frontend-only verification of the compact design pattern (from Offices) applied to Users, Roles, and Clients pages. All requested checks passed: tbl-density table class present on all three lists, UPPERCASE headers, toolbar card with search 'Search...', page-size and density toggle working, Detail (Eye) menu item in place with correct testids (users-detail-*, roles-detail-*, client-detail-*), Copy ID removed from all three action menus, Detail navigates to edit pages with 'Detail User/Role' title and breadcrumb, clients Detail opens clients-form-dialog. User create flow works end-to-end with form-dense container; test user was created and cleaned up. Regression: /offices, /users/new, /roles/new, /offices/new all load without crash.
critical_code_review_comments: Users list has no explicit data-testid on prev/next pagination buttons (users-pagination-prev/next). Adding testids would improve automated pagination testing (currently must fall back to text 'Next'/'Prev' which is absent — the buttons are icon-only).
Office combobox on /users/new returned an empty label ('None') for the first item; verify Offices seed data doesn't have entries without a display label.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST Compact <ts> user and deleted after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Compact design pattern verified across Users/Roles/Clients. Row action menus: users menu has [Detail, Change password, Reset to default, Deactivate, Delete]; roles menu has [Move left, Move right, Detail, Delete]; clients menu has [View usage, Detail, Regenerate key, Revoke, Delete]. Density toggle exposes 'Dense'/'Comfortable' radio items; row height changed 37px->53px on toggle. Pagination prev/next are icon-only buttons without data-testids.
